subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Katheryne in Liyue Harbor

706530101.text: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome, Adventurer. I've been waiting for your arrival.

706530103.text: Thank you for your concern, I'm fine. However, the Guild is facing yet another emergency...

706530106.text: In the past few days, the Adventurers' Guild has received many eyewitness reports of Geovishaps.

706530107.text: Up till recently, the only known Geovishap sightings were those recorded in ancient texts. No one knows why they are suddenly making an appearance now.

706530108.text: They look quite similar to Geovishap Hatchlings, but they are very aggressive and possess far more destructive power.

706530109.text: During this time, many people are heading out to remote locations to sight-see and release lanterns. If they were to run into a Geovishap, the consequences would be dire indeed.

706530110.text: Unfortunately for us, many adventurers have now gone to see their families and friends. As such, we're currently experiencing a severe shortage of staff.

706530105.text: Indeed, and it is an emergency.
